'''Waks Trode''' was an [[Ishi Tib]] who,<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> in [[19 BBY]],<ref name="GA">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY]].</ref> was present in the [[Galaxies Opera House]] in the [[Uscru District]] of the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] during a performance of the [[opera]] ''[[Squid Lake]]''.<ref name="USWNE">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> Trode was stood in one of the building's corridors conversing with<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> fellow Ishi Tib [[Gume Saam]]—a [[senator]] for the [[Techno Union]]<ref name="Visual Dictionary" />—when the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] rushed past them on his way to meet [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]].<ref name="ROTS" /> Trode had [[Color|green]] skin and brown [[eye]]s on prominent eyestalks. While at the opera house, the Ishi Tib wore an old-gold colored [[Jacket|coat]] and [[Clothing|robes]].<ref name="Visual Dictionary" />

==Behind the scenes==
Waks Trode first appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="ROTS" /> which was released on [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="YbY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> The opera house corridor shot was filmed entirely on blue-screen<ref name="SkywalkerSage">''[[Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'' — [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']]: "ILM Episode III Siggraph Reel"</ref> and Trode's costume consisted of an old-gold quilted silk coat and robe.<ref name="DressingAGalaxy">''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]''</ref> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character was first identified in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The [[Waks Trode/Legends|character's]] name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[James Luceno]]<ref name="ROTS VD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and released prior to the film on [[April 2]], 2005.<ref name="Amazon">{{DK|url=us/9780756611286-star-wars-revenge-of-the-sith-the-visual-dictionary|text=Star Wars Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary|nolive=1}}</ref>
